# **DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY** ### ## th ### ### 1) the IRDA (Insurance Broker) Regulations, 2013 it is hereby informed to concerned that the Authority has granted approval to: National Insurance Academy (NIA), Pune to undertake online training for becoming broker trained person and renewal training for broker qualified persons. 2) Insurance Broker Association of India (IBAI) to undertake renewal training for broker qualified persons. approval is subject to the following: a. The training shall be conducted in online mode. b. be fair to both the parties. - c. The organization shall under no circumstances force, induce or use - means directly or indirectly to - course. - approval is granted on 22 nd November, 2017. 0 6) : +91-40-23381100/300, Fax: +91-40-6682 3334
